# JavaScript Code Analysis

The JavaScript Analyzer is designed to analyze JavaScript source files and extract information about components, dependencies, and API endpoints. It supports multiple JavaScript file extensions and employs the tree-sitter library for parsing, producing a consistent vocabulary of facts for further processing.
